user.title: Smart Heat Pump configuration
user.description: Link the sensors and controls of your heat pump. Only room and outdoor temperature are required; the more sensors, the smarter the control.

data_description.room_temp_sensor: Most representative indoor temperature, e.g. the living room.
data_description.outside_temp_sensor: Preferably a sensor that is not in direct sun.
data_description.target_setpoint_entity: Entity that sets the water temperature target of the heat pump (e.g. Tuya Local). Empty = monitor and learn only.
data_description.heatpump_switch: Optional. Only used in summer mode or on serious overheating.
data_description.control_mode: Which water temperature your heat pump's target refers to.
data_description.setpoint_step: Resolution of the heat pump (many Tuya units: 1 °C). The controller averages over time automatically.
data_description.return_temp_sensor: Needed to learn the floor model (or use a floor sensor).
data_description.flow_temp_sensor: Needed to learn how fast the floor heats up.
data_description.floor_temp_sensor: Optional, makes the model more accurate. Without it the return temperature is used.
data_description.compressor_freq_sensor: Tells the controller when the pump is really heating.
data_description.voltage_sensor: Only if there is no power sensor.
data_description.current_sensor: Only if there is no power sensor.
data_description.flow_rate_sensor_2: Only for parallel circuits that should be added up.
data_description.weather_entity: For outdoor temperature and sun forecast.
data_description.electricity_price_sensor: Optional. A forecast in the attributes (Nordpool, EPEX, Frank Energie, ENTSO-E) is detected automatically.
data_description.pv_power_sensor: Optional. With a surplus, cheaper/free heat is stored in the floor.
data_description.dhw_temp_sensor: Optional. Only fill in if the heat pump also makes hot water; enables the DHW function.
data_description.dhw_switch: Switch that starts/stops a hot water cycle.
data_description.dhw_setpoint_entity: Optional: set to the wanted temperature during a cycle.
data_description.open_sensors: Optional. If something stays open longer than the set time, heating pauses (with frost protection) and nothing is learned from that period.
data_description.presence_entities: Optional. If nobody is home, the temperature drops to the away setpoint.
data_description.holiday_entity: Optional. While on, the away setpoint always applies.
data_description.return_time_entity: Optional, e.g. an input_datetime. Floor heating is slow: with a return time it pre-heats in time.
data_description.grid_power_sensor: Optional. Power drawn from the grid (positive = import). When the limit stays exceeded, heating pauses briefly (capacity tariff or battery protection).
